hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Each active token at index i can remain or shift to cover adjacent positions.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Track dynamic programming states for covering current index with or without active token presence.

hints.text: Sum the values of covered positions to determine the maximum achievable total.
